content.text:
Apply Gmail labels to EXISTING threads for Tyson Goulding (tyson.goulding@optconnect.com). Read-mostly plus labeling. Do NOT create/delete filters. Do NOT skip inbox, archive, mark read, trash, or delete except you may add labels.

Use Gmail MCP namespace user-Gmail. GetDynamicTools for schema before each new tool. Never print secrets.

LABEL IDS:
- Carrier = Label_9
- Internal = Label_10
- Incidents = Label_11
- External = Label_12
- Customer = Label_7092668047386969327 (already exists, name Customer)
- NOISE = Label_8235953576398871284
- calendar = Label_194611383647547567

Use search_threads (THREAD_VIEW_MINIMAL) then label_thread (adds labels; does not remove inbox).

BATCHES (search, then label each thread id; page if needed; cap at ~50 threads per query to stay sane):

1. Carrier (stay inbox):
   - from:t-mobile.com
   - from:att.com OR from:att.net
   - from:tealcom.freshdesk.com OR from:tealcommunications.com OR from:tealcomminications.com
   Also label threads that already have ATT/*, TMO/*, Verizon, VZW user labels if you can find them via those label ids:
   - ATT/ATT-TPS Label_1594130435008509118
   - ATT/ATT-5G NSA Label_1642289123798451590
   - ATT/ATT-APN [M2M] Label_643809039603583225
   - ATT/ATT-APN [DPL] Label_9176568754687088213
   - TMO/TMO-DIRECT Label_5761409400949696604
   - Verizon Label_6692434039248376877
   - VZW Label_6706258625363735496
   Do NOT label donotreply@verizon.com Service Bulletin threads as Carrier (those stay NOISE only).

2. Incidents (stay inbox):
   - from:no-reply@pagerduty.com (NOT Success@pagerduty.com)

3. Internal (stay inbox):
   - subject:"Secure Token" from:lattigo.com OR from:no-reply@lattigo.com
   - to:net-eng@optconnect.com newer_than:30d (or in:inbox to:net-eng@optconnect.com)
   - from:andy.cutright@optconnect.com, from:matthew.berger@optconnect.com, from:victor.juarez@optconnect.com, from:spencer.campbell@optconnect.com if they are writing Tyson (in:inbox newer_than:30d is enough)

4. Customer (stay inbox) — search and label if found:
   - hydria OR from:preferredcontrols.com OR from:mobilemoney.net OR from:alliancels.com OR novacharge OR from:chargeupev.com

5. External (stay inbox):
   - from:noreply@github.com (account/security; NOT notifications@github.com)
   - AWS health / Important notice from eng@pws.bz if clearly external vendor notice (optional, skip if ambiguous)

6. Do NOT add NOISE yourself unless a thread is clearly leftover promo still in inbox (googlecloud@, cisco engage, salesforce, gallup, Success@pagerduty, rewardgateway). Prefer leaving those for the new filters' "also apply". If you do label NOISE, still do not remove INBOX in this task (filters will archive).

SAFETY: Never remove INBOX or UNREAD. Never touch Secure Token except adding Internal. Never dump net-eng@ to NOISE.

Report counts labeled per bucket and any leftovers you could not tag.
I'll inspect the Gmail MCP tools first, then search existing threads by your batches and only add the listed labels.
Searching the first labeling batches now, excluding threads that already have the target label.

python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re,os
files=[
'/home/box/.cursor-server/agent-tools/e059ee6a-11c2-44a4-8778-3a4659e1417a.txt',
'/home/box/.cursor-server/agent-tools/d687c992-4502-4f65-84c7-1bcd5c3fe905.txt',
'/home/box/.cursor-server/agent-tools/b2a1da1a-e1b6-41cc-aaf4-d1c11e3837ea.txt',
]
for f in files:
    print('====', os.path.basename(f), '====')
    text=open(f).read()
    # try json
    try:
        data=json.loads(text)
        threads=data.get('threads',[])
        print('count',len(threads),'estimate',data.get('resultCountEstimate'),'next',data.get('nextPageToken') or data.get('next_page_token'))
        for t in threads:
            subj=t.get('messages',[{}])[0].get('subject','')[:80]
            sender=t.get('messages',[{}])[0].get('sender','')
            labels=t.get('messages',[{}])[0].get('labelIds',[])
            print(t['id'], '|', sender, '|', subj, '|', ','.join(labels[:8]))
    except Exception as e:
        print('json fail', e)
        ids=re.findall(r'"id": "([0-9a-f]{10,})"', text)
        print('raw ids', len(ids), ids[:20])
        if 'nextPageToken' in text or 'next_page_token' in text:
            print('HAS PAGE TOKEN')
            m=re.search(r'pageToken["\s:]+([^\s",]+)', text)
            print(m.group(0) if m else 'no extract')
PY
